farmingTypes.title: Precision Agriculture (Site-Specific Farming)
farmingTypes.summary: Uses GPS, soil moisture sensors, drone NDVI imagery, and variable-rate fertilizer application to deliver exact water and nutrients only where each patch of the field needs it.
howToStart: Start with a free Soil Health Card test to map N-P-K zones.
Use free satellite NDVI apps or rent Kisan Drones via Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
Pair drip lines with low-cost soil moisture tensiometers.

farmingTypes.title: Hydroponics (Soilless Nutrient-Film Farming)
farmingTypes.initialCost: Medium–High (Rs. 1.5–4 lakh for small commercial unit)
farmingTypes.summary: Grows high-value vegetables and herbs in mineral nutrient-rich water solutions (NFT channels, Deep Water Culture, or Cocopeat Dutch Buckets) with zero soil-borne disease.
howToStart: Begin with a 50–100 plant Kratky or NFT pilot frame using an EC & pH meter.
Target urban supermarkets, restaurants, and direct D2C subscriptions.

farmingTypes.title: Polyhouse & Shade-Net Protected Cultivation
farmingTypes.initialCost: High (Rs. 8–10 lakh per 1000 sq.m before subsidy)
farmingTypes.summary: Naturally ventilated UV-stabilized polyhouses shield high-value off-season crops from extreme heat, hailstorms, and virus vectors like whiteflies.
howToStart: Apply for MIDH/NHB subsidy on your State Horticulture portal before construction.
Use drip fertigation with water-soluble fertilizers (19:19:19, 13:0:45).

farmingTypes.title: Drip Irrigation & Automated Fertigation
farmingTypes.summary: Delivers water and dissolved fertilizers directly to the active root zone drop-by-drop via venturi injectors, cutting weed growth and fertilizer runoff.
howToStart: Register on State DBT Micro-Irrigation portal with land record and empaneled vendor quotation.
Add a Venturi injector to feed liquid fertilizers directly through the drip mainline.

farmingTypes.title: Natural Farming (ZBNF / Bharatiya Prakritik Krishi)
farmingTypes.govtSubsidy: PKVY / National Mission on Natural Farming (Rs. 31,500/ha)
farmingTypes.summary: Eliminates synthetic chemicals using 4 pillars: Beejamrit (seed treatment), Jeevamrit (microbial soil booster), Acchadana (crop residue mulching), and Whapasa (soil aeration).
howToStart: Prepare Jeevamrit drum (cow dung, cow urine, jaggery, pulse flour, living soil) and apply with irrigation.
Form a 20-farmer cluster to avail PKVY PGS-India organic certification.

farmingTypes.title: Integrated Farming System (IFS — Crop + Dairy + Poultry/Fish)
farmingTypes.govtSubsidy: RKVY, NABARD Dairy & PM Matsya Sampada Yojana
farmingTypes.summary: Recycles waste from one enterprise as input for another: crop residue feeds dairy cattle, cow dung runs biogas & vermicompost, and pond silt fertilizes horticulture.
howToStart: Integrate 2–3 milch cows or a farm pond with fisheries + border fruit trees.
Add a low-cost vermicompost pit to convert manure into high-value organic fertilizer.

farmingTypes.title: Vertical Farming & Aeroponics
farmingTypes.govtSubsidy: Startup India / AIF / State Agri-Tech Grants
farmingTypes.summary: Roots hang suspended in air and receive ultra-fine nutrient mist under spectrum-tuned LEDs — widely used in India for virus-free Potato mini-tuber seed production and leafy greens.
howToStart: Take training at CPRI (Central Potato Research Institute) or IIHR Bengaluru before investing.
Focus on high-margin seed tubers or urban microgreens with guaranteed buyers.

farmingTypes.title: Agroforestry & Multi-Layer Orchard Intercropping
farmingTypes.summary: Combines high-value trees (Poplar, Melia Dubia, Teak, Mango, Amla, Sandalwood) with intercrops like turmeric, ginger, wheat, or pulses for shade-tolerant multi-tier income.
howToStart: Plant fast-growing boundary trees first to act as windbreaks and carbon credits.
Match shade-loving intercrops (turmeric, ginger, colocasia) once canopy closes.

dailyAdvancements.title: Kisan Agri-Drones & Nano-Urea Aerial Spraying
dailyAdvancements.impact: Sprays 1 acre in 7–10 minutes with 90% less water and zero operator chemical exposure.
dailyAdvancements.accessibility: Available on rent via FPOs/CHCs (~Rs. 400–600/acre); 50–80% SMAM subsidy.
dailyAdvancements.summary: DGCA-certified agricultural drones pair with IFFCO Nano Urea / Nano DAP to deliver uniform ultra-low-volume foliar sprays even in tall sugarcane and muddy paddy fields.

dailyAdvancements.title: Smartphone AI Crop Disease & Pest Diagnostics
dailyAdvancements.impact: Instant leaf diagnosis in <3 seconds prevents 20–40% yield loss from late treatment.
dailyAdvancements.accessibility: 100% Free via open-source tools like KrishiAI (HuggingFace Vision models).
dailyAdvancements.summary: Deep learning classifiers trained on 100,000+ South Asian crop leaf images identify blights, rusts, and viruses directly from a farmer's smartphone camera.

dailyAdvancements.title: Low-Cost IoT Soil Moisture & Automatic Pump Controllers
dailyAdvancements.impact: Prevents over-irrigation, saves 35% electricity/water, and stops dry-run motor burnout.
dailyAdvancements.accessibility: GSM mobile pump starters cost Rs. 3,000–6,000; IoT sensor nodes Rs. 8,000–15,000.
dailyAdvancements.summary: Farmers turn borewell pumps ON/OFF via missed call or smartphone app while automated soil sensors trigger drip valves only when root-zone moisture dips below threshold.

dailyAdvancements.title: Satellite NDVI Crop Health & Yield Monitoring
dailyAdvancements.impact: Detects water stress, nutrient deficiency, or pest patches 7–10 days before visible to the eye.
dailyAdvancements.accessibility: Free Sentinel-2 imagery & open-source GIS platforms.
dailyAdvancements.summary: Multispectral satellite indices (NDVI, NDWI) track biomass vigor across entire villages, powering faster PMFBY crop insurance claim verification and precision scouting.

dailyAdvancements.title: Solar Water Pumps & Agrivoltaics (PM-KUSUM)
dailyAdvancements.impact: Eliminates diesel costs and daytime power cuts; surplus power can be sold back to the grid.
dailyAdvancements.accessibility: Up to 60% Central + State subsidy under PM-KUSUM.
dailyAdvancements.summary: Standalone 3–7.5 HP solar pumps deliver reliable daytime irrigation, while elevated agrivoltaic panels let shade-tolerant crops grow directly underneath solar arrays.

dailyAdvancements.title: Decentralized Solar Cold Storage (On-Farm Micro-Chillers)
dailyAdvancements.impact: Extends tomato, onion, and fruit shelf-life by 3–5×, eliminating distress mandi selling.
dailyAdvancements.accessibility: Eligible for 3% interest subvention & credit guarantee under AIF.
dailyAdvancements.summary: Thermal-battery solar cold rooms operate off-grid at the village/FPO level, allowing farmers to hold perishable harvests until mandi prices recover.

dailyAdvancements.title: e-NAM Digital Auctions & AI Price Forecasting
dailyAdvancements.impact: Transparent pan-India bidding, electronic weighing, and instant DBT settlement.
dailyAdvancements.summary: Combines live APMC mandi arrivals with time-series ML price forecasting so farmers can decide whether to sell immediately, hold, or sell to higher-paying nearby mandis.

dailyAdvancements.title: Nano Urea, Nano DAP & Biological Consortia
dailyAdvancements.impact: A 500 ml bottle replaces a 45 kg Urea bag, slashing transport cost and groundwater nitrate leaching.
dailyAdvancements.accessibility: Widely available at PACS, IFFCO centres (~Rs. 225–600/bottle).
dailyAdvancements.summary: Nano-sized nutrient particles (20–50 nm) achieve >80% foliar absorption efficiency compared to 30–40% for conventional granular urea.
